text:
I hope you're well. Following up on our chat last November, where I said I was interested in moving from GTB in Bolivia to a spot in Enron where my experience could be used more effectively. You suggested I speak with Jeff McMahon at EIM, as my background seemed well suited to his group.
Since then I've been focused on wrapping up some critical matters at GTB and have made good progress. Spoke with Jeff on Monday about joining EIM and he was really keen. I should hear back soon, would be really good if you could put a good word in for me. EIM is a good fit and I think I can help out with his efforts to push into Europe and expand.
Regards
Nasim
